# Automotive & Connected Car: TSP, T-Box, MQTT/IoT, OTA (Uptane) & Digital Key (`automotive-connected-car-ota-tbox`)

> **Group:** IV. Physical-Cyber: Automotive, EV Charging, Robotics & OT
> **Product Archetypes:** Connected_Car_TBox_OTA
> **Trigger Signals:** vin, tbox, telematics, tsp, ota, uptane, fota, can, uds, someip, doip, mqtt, vehicle, automotive

## [ BLOCK: tsp-remote-vehicle-commands-and-vin-bola ]
### TSP Remote Vehicle Commands (Unlock, Start, HVAC, Immobilize) & VIN BOLA
- For every Telematics Service Provider (TSP) endpoint accepting a `vin` or `vehicle_id`, verify strict ownership binding (`user_id <-> vin` active relationship, primary vs secondary driver permissions, expired rental/lease revocation).
- Check remote actuation commands (door unlock, trunk open, remote start/hv_enable, horn/lights, immobilizer, speed limit, valet mode) for step-up authentication (PIN/biometric/FIDO2), command expiry timestamp, monotonic nonce, and vehicle state preconditions (Gear = Park, Speed = 0).

## [ BLOCK: mqtt-iot-topic-acl-and-fleet-broadcast ]
### MQTT / AWS IoT Core Topic ACLs (`vehicles/{vin}/#`) & Fleet-Wide Broadcast
- Inspect MQTT broker ACLs (AWS IoT Policy, EMQX, Mosquitto, HiveMQ, VerneMQ). Check if a single compromised T-Box credential or backend service can subscribe to `vehicles/+/telemetry` (mass GPS tracking) or publish to `vehicles/+/command` (fleet-wide actuation).

## [ BLOCK: ota-fota-uptane-signature-and-rollback ]
### OTA / FOTA Campaign Management, Uptane Metadata Signing & Anti-Rollback
- Trace OTA campaign creation and firmware package delivery (Uptane/TUF, S3 presigned URLs, delta packages).
- Check whether firmware images and metadata manifests are signed offline (HSM/KMS) and verified on the vehicle before flashing, and whether anti-rollback counters prevent downgrading ECUs to vulnerable firmware versions.

## [ BLOCK: tbox-can-uds-gateway-and-digital-key ]
### T-Box / Gateway CAN/UDS/DoIP Filtering & Digital Key (CCC/BLE/NFC)
- Check T-Box / Central Gateway code (C/C++/Go/Android Automotive) for unvalidated pass-through of UDS diagnostic services (`0x10` DiagnosticSessionControl, `0x27` SecurityAccess, `0x2E` WriteDataByIdentifier, `0x31` RoutineControl, `0x34` RequestDownload) from cellular/Wi-Fi/BLE to safety-critical CAN buses.

### Standard Mappings
- ISO-SAE-21434, UNECE-R155, UNECE-R156, OWASP-API1:2023, ASVS-5.0-V6-Authentication, ASVS-5.0-V8-Authorization, ASVS-5.0-V11-Cryptography, CWE-285, CWE-347, CWE-494

### Safe Patterns (Refutation Anchors)
- Spring Boot / Go TSP command handler verifying active vehicle ownership (SELECT 1 FROM user_vehicles WHERE user_id = $1 AND vin = $2 AND status = 'ACTIVE') plus step-up FIDO2/PIN token and signed command nonce
- Per-vehicle X.509 client certificate (mTLS) with AWS IoT Core / EMQX broker policy restricting MQTT publish/subscribe strictly to vehicles/${iot:Connection.Thing.ThingName}/*
- Uptane / TUF dual-signature verification (Director + Image repository) in C/C++ OTA client with hardware HSM/TPM monotonic anti-rollback counter check before flashing
- C/C++ T-Box CAN/UDS gateway enforcing vehicle speed == 0 km/h and Gear == PARK interlock before forwarding any remote actuation or UDS 0x27/0x31 diagnostic frame

### Vulnerable Patterns
- TSP REST/gRPC endpoint (POST /api/v1/vehicles/{vin}/command) sending MQTT unlock/start/immobilize payload based on path VIN without verifying req.user ownership of that VIN
- Shared MQTT broker credentials across vehicles or wildcard MQTT ACLs (vehicles/+/command, vehicles/#) allowing a single compromised T-Box to broadcast commands fleet-wide
- OTA manifest delivering unsigned or HTTP/presigned-S3 firmware URLs without cryptographic signature and anti-rollback version verification on the vehicle ECU
- C/C++ T-Box daemon forwarding JSON/Protobuf payload fields from MQTT directly to SocketCAN write(can_fd, &frame, sizeof(frame)) without command allowlisting or Park/Zero-Speed interlock

### Mandatory Evidence (`required_evidence`)
- ev_... excerpt of TSP vehicle command controller/service and VIN ownership lookup
- ev_... excerpt of MQTT ACL/IoT policy, OTA manifest verification, or T-Box command handler

### Verification Questions When Static Code Is Inconclusive (`questions_when_unclear`)
- Does the T-Box or Body Control Module (BCM) hardware reject remote unlock/start/OTA commands when vehicle speed > 0 or gear != P?
- Does the MQTT broker (AWS IoT Core / EMQX) enforce per-VIN client certificate CN matching on topic publish/subscribe?
